privileged_info_for_vlm: The edge class must be named 'NearBy'. Properties must be 'Distance' (DOUBLE) and 'City' (STRING). The Earth radius for the Haversine formula is exactly 6371 km. The report must be saved to /home/ga/proximity_report.txt. The report format requires a specific pipe-delimited string: '{City} | {Hotel} -> {Restaurant} | {Distance} km' and must end with 'Total pairs: {N}'.
